_upm.changelog:
Added
- NDI Sender: Source Rect for sending a region of the source texture.
- NDI Sender: SendAudio for sending audio samples from any thread.
- NDI Audio Capture component that forwards the audio passing through its GameObject to an NDI Sender.
- NDI Receiver: Receive Audio option for mixing received audio into an AudioSource on the same GameObject.

Changed
- Frames no longer have to be multiples of 16x8. The width only has to be a multiple of 2 (a multiple of 4 with alpha).
- Video frames are sent with synthesized timecodes so that NDI can align them with audio.
- NdiSender.ndiName returns the serialized name before the component initializes.
- The NDI Receiver skips frames it can't decode (odd widths, unaligned widths with alpha, or padded rows) instead of decoding them with broken indices.
